countries-description: Select where the players listed on the leaderboard come from.
world-map-description: Use this menu to select multiple countries using a world map.
select-multiple-regions-description: Enable this option to select multiple countries or subdivisions.
gsv-only-description: Enable this option to only display players who registered to Global Stats Viewer.
lb-combo-description: Allows you to combine multiple leaderboards together, granted the combination makes sense.
filter-search-guide: You can filter your search and select a different leaderboard using the buttons above and below.
